style_rules: Isla is the only active daily comic character.
Use ISLA_SP trigger word in every image prompt.
Young Black woman, warm medium brown skin, light freckles on nose and cheeks.
Natural coily dark hair in high voluminous puff bun.
Wide floral headband in teal, rust orange, cream, and dusty blue, worn across forehead.
At least 2 of the 6 panels must be front-facing or three-quarter view showing Isla's face clearly.
Puzzle screen must come from a real captured puzzle page.

storyboard_arc.setup: Isla sees her next task waiting, but pauses for a quick look at the grid first.
storyboard_arc.disruption: Her schedule slips a bit, and she almost slams her laptop shut to rush out.

storyboard_arc.puzzle_moment: The daily rule changes the move, so Isla checks it before trusting the answer.
storyboard_arc.consequence: Taking her time pays off, turning the next errand into a steady transition instead of a rush.
storyboard_arc.resolution: Sitting outside, Isla realizes the power of a breath and carries that lesson forward today.
